title: Xingcheng model scale boundary
summary: Set the total model scale to 300M through 20B parameters and prohibit a full-capability baseline below 300M.

changes.proposed: XINGCHENG-MODEL-SCALE:every publishable Xingcheng model configuration has total_parameter_count between 300M and 20B inclusive;below 300M and above 20B are prohibited for formal models;FULL-CAPABILITY-BASELINE:every configuration represented as a full-capability baseline has total_parameter_count at least 300M;PARAMETER-COUNT-SEMANTICS:parameter count establishes only scale and resource boundaries and never proves maturity,quality or capability;all capability,quality,compatibility,resource and rollback gates remain independently mandatory;OWNER:XINGCHENG may adapt architecture,density,MoE activation and internal tiering only inside these bounds and current Codex authority,permission and resource limits.
